name: detent
moment: dragging a hand-wheel: one click each time it passes a stop (throttled)
prompt: Single heavy metallic ratchet click of an iron valve wheel turning one notch, close up, short and dry

name: wheel
moment: a stop is set on an inlet (wheel released or stop button pressed): the valve seats
prompt: A brass hand wheel on an old iron gate valve turned a quarter turn, metal squeak of the stem, then the valve seating with a solid dull clunk

name: spec-open
moment: an outlet spec opens (reading the evidence)
prompt: A laminated card spec sheet pulled from a steel clip holder on a metal panel, crisp card slide and a small metallic clip snap

name: call
moment: round 1: an outlet is called goes dark or survives
prompt: A grease pencil marking a quick firm tick on a card tag, short scratchy stroke, close up

name: run-plan
moment: Run their plan pressed (the round 1 commit): every wheel turns to the customer's stops
prompt: Several heavy iron valve wheels cranked at once in a pump room, metal stems grinding and squealing, water in the pipes surging and knocking as the valves close

name: log-shift
prompt: A heavy rubber date stamp slammed onto a thick paper logbook on a steel desk, one solid thump

name: lamp-out
moment: reveal: an outlet goes dark (detection lamp dies, board degrades)
prompt: An industrial indicator lamp losing power: a relay dropping out with a hard click, then the electrical buzz of the bulb dying away

name: lamp-on
moment: reveal: an outlet comes back (lamp restored, board full)
prompt: An industrial relay pulling in with a firm clack and a bulb filament buzzing on steadily, electrical panel

name: tank-drain
moment: reveal: the retention tank starts draining
prompt: Water draining out of a large glass tank through a steel pipe, deep hollow gurgle and glugging

name: all-clear
moment: reveal, right: every round 1 call held / shift logged on target with nothing dark
prompt: A large steam pressure valve relieving with a steady soft hiss that settles, then a heavy steel latch closing with a calm solid clunk

name: alarm
moment: reveal, wrong: an outlet you did not call went dark / shift logged off target or with something dark
prompt: An old industrial alarm bell ringing in a concrete pump room for two seconds, loud electric clapper bell, then cut off
